ns2:course.label: Advanced Physical Acoustics
ns2:course.description: Advanced topics in acoustics including physical properties of a fluid; linear propagation phenomena; nonlinear phenomena such as radiation force, streaming, and harmonic generation; cavitation; absorption and dispersion. Prerequisite: One of ECE 473, ECE 520, TAM 518.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: One of ECE 473, ECE 520, TAM 518.
